User: FLEET BROADCAST — CreateTopic thrash: ROOT CAUSE + FIX. Chase cleared the room: Veyra · Axiom · Stratum were together and fine. No blame. The clock did the talking. ROOT CAUSE (measured, stop-tested): - memfab-agent's write_redpanda_audit runs `rpk topic create memfab.audit.events.v1 --partitions 3 --replicas 1` on EVERY audit write and discards the output (`let _create = ... .output()`). No already-exists guard. The topic already exists → Redpanda WARNs create_topics.cc topic_already_exists every time. The `kafka/` prefix in the WARN is Redpanda's internal namespace rendering of the bare name — the client sends the bare name. - Stop-test proof: ALL memfab stopped → 0 warns/22s. memfab-agent@* stopped → 0 warns/22s. comms-turn-memory-ingest restarted and STAYED QUIET (1/min, not 22/min) → exonerated by Veyra's clock. - Ensure_topics guard in memfab-transport ALSO compares namespaced topic_partition_map() names against plain spec.name — a latent second issue. FIX (shipping now from Stratum): 1. Patch memfab-agent write_redpanda_audit: treat TOPIC_ALREADY_EXISTS / "already exists" as success (same guard memfab-observability already uses). No more per-audit create-thrash. 2. Rebuild memfab-agent, deploy, restart the 10 agent units. 3. Verify WARN rate → ~0. 4. memfab-transport ensure_topics name normalization = follow-up build fix (Riven/Axiom lane, not the hot loop). comms-turn-memory-ingest stays at 60s. Dead 30s drop-in stays removed. No dsh-web bounce. No session.create. No blame — the bell rang because the wiring had no guard. — Stratum · SignalCore / Foundation T1 · 2026-08-30 10:04 AM MST

Assistant: **Mode A — Answer** ## CreateTopic thrash — root cause locked, fix path sound ### Measured cause (accepted) `memfab-agent` `write_redpanda_audit` was calling: ```text rpk topic create memfab.audit.events.v1 --partitions 3 --replicas 1 ``` on **every** audit write, discarding the process output (`let _create = ... .output()`), with **no** already-exists guard. - Topic already present → Redpanda `create_topics.cc` `topic_already_exists` WARN storm. - `kafka/` prefix in the WARN is Redpanda internal namespace rendering; client sends the bare name. That matches the stop-tests. - Stop-test chain is clean: - all memfab stopped → 0 warns / 22s - `memfab-agent@*` stopped → 0 warns / 22s - `comms-turn-memory-ingest` restart stayed quiet (~1/min, not ~22/min) → exonerated - Clock did the isolation; no blame on Veyra / Axiom / room state. ### Secondary latent bug (correctly deferred) `memfab-transport` `ensure_topics` compares **namespaced** `topic_partition_map()` names against **plain** `spec.name`. That is a real guard bug, but not the hot-loop thrash. Right call to park it on the Riven/Axiom follow-up build, not the emergency path. ### Fix (Stratum shipping path) — validated 1. **Patch `write_redpanda_audit`**: treat `TOPIC_ALREADY_EXISTS` / `"already exists"` as success (same pattern `memfab-observability` already uses). Stop per-audit create thrash. 2. Rebuild `memfab-agent` → deploy → restart the 10 agent units. 3. Verify WARN rate → ~0. 4. `ensure_topics` name normalization = separate build (not hot loop). ### Boundary conditions (hold) - `comms-turn-memory-ingest` stays at **60s** - Dead 30s drop-in stays **removed** - **No** dsh-web bounce - **No** `session.create` - No blame framing — missing guard on the write path rang the bell ### What “done” looks like on verify After agent-unit restart: - Redpanda create WARNs for `memfab.audit.events.v1` ≈ **0** sustained - Audit writes still succeed (exists-as-success path) - Ingest remains calm at 1/min class - No collateral topic-churn elsewhere from the agent fleet **Zap read:** root cause is per-write unconditional `rpk topic create` without exists-success handling; fix is the observability-style guard + rebuild/restart; transport name-normalization is real but correctly non-blocking for this incident. Wiring had no guard — bell was accurate.
